entries.title: Shedden v. Principi - Direct Service Connection
entries.content:
CAVC SERVICE CONNECTION PRECEDENT

CASE: Shedden v. Principi
CITATION: 381 F.3d 1163
TOPIC: Direct Service Connection

HOLDING:
Three-element test: current disability, in-service event, nexus

LEGAL FRAMEWORK:
Service connection requires: (1) current disability, (2) in-service incurrence/aggravation, 
(3) nexus between current disability and service.

APPLICATION:
This case establishes binding precedent for service connection analysis.
